prompt: A question you got wrong last week is on your missed list. You retake the test and get it right. What happens to it?
options: It leaves the list, with no schedule and nothing due
It stays until you have got it right three times
It moves to a review queue with a date on it
It leaves the list and the old attempt is deleted
explanation: Missed is a plain list of what you got wrong and have not since got right. Getting it right removes it. The old attempt stays in the record: nothing is deleted to tidy the list up.
